faces.name: The Gaffer
faces.oracleText: At the beginning of each end step, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, draw a card.

faces.name: The Game-Changing Host
faces.oracleText:
Anything that could have changed The Game-Changing Host on the turn it enters applies retroactively. (He's been here the whole time.)
{T}: Create a copy of a game changer at random. You may play the copy without paying its mana cost. (There are currently 61. Perhaps look at a list and randomize?)

faces.name: The Gaming Explainer
faces.oracleText:
+1: Draw a card. Add two mana of any one color. Spend this mana only to cast spells or activate abilities that have reminder text. (This is reminder text.)
−3: For each player, return up to one target nonland permanent that player controls without reminder text to its owners hand.
−7: Exile the top seven cards of your library. Cast any number of spells from among them with reminder text without paying their mana costs.
The Gaming Explainer can be your commander.

faces.name: The General
faces.oracleText: Exile The General: Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. Untap them.

faces.name: The Generational Historian
faces.oracleText:
Before the game begins, if The Generational Historian is your commander, choose a year. Your deck can contain only cards released in that year. (Legal text, for once, is a great place to check. Specific versions matter.)
Spells released in the chosen year cost {1} less to cast. If the chosen year is in the 1990s, they also cost {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} less to cast, reducing only the amount of colored mana you pay.

faces.name: The Ghoul, Gunslinger
faces.oracleText:
First strike
Whenever The Ghoul or another nontoken Zombie or Mutant you control dies, target player gets two rad counters. If that player is you, create a Treasure token.

faces.name: The Girl in the Fireplace
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Create a 1/1 white Human Noble creature token with vanishing 3 and "Prevent all damage that would be dealt to this token."
II — Create a 2/2 white Horse creature token with "Doctors you control have horsemanship." (They can't be blocked except by creatures with horsemanship.)
III — Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player this turn, time travel.

faces.name: The Gitrog Monster
faces.oracleText:
Deathtouch
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice The Gitrog Monster unless you sacrifice a land.
You may play an additional land on each of your turns.
Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere, draw a card.
